```{r}
#| label: setup
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)

# Resolve project files whether the app is served from the project root or
# from src/reference.

dashboard_source <-
  c("src/r/grading_pipeline.R", "../r/grading_pipeline.R") %>%
  keep(fs::file_exists) %>%
  first()

source(dashboard_source)

# When this document was last edited. Shown in the header because Quarto
# serves a shiny document from a temporary render, so there is otherwise no
# way to tell a stale page from a fresh one.

dashboard_built <-
  c("src/reference/grading_dashboard.qmd", "grading_dashboard.qmd") %>%
  keep(fs::file_exists) %>%
  first() %>%
  file.info() %>%
  pull(mtime) %>%
  format("%d %b %H:%M")

# Which problem set to review.
#
# A quarto shiny document takes no arguments, so run_grading_dashboard()
# passes it in the environment. One grading session is one problem set,
# which is why there is no picker for it on the page.

graded_problem_sets <-
  1:7 %>%
  keep(\(.n) fs::file_exists(grading_results_path(.n)))

if (!length(graded_problem_sets)) {
  cli::cli_abort(
    "No graded run to show -- call {.code grade_problem_set(n)} first."
  )
}

dashboard_problem_set <-
  local({
    asked <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("GRADING_PROBLEM_SET")))

    if (length(asked) == 1 && !is.na(asked) && asked %in% graded_problem_sets) {
      asked
    } else {
      graded_problem_sets[1]
    }
  })
```

```{r}
#| label: server
#| context: server

results <-
  reactiveVal(read_grading_results(dashboard_problem_set))

problem_questions <-
  reactiveVal(questions_from_qmd(dashboard_problem_set))

# blinding ----------------------------------------------------------------

# A deterministic number for one student's answer to one part, used to order
# the responses. It is not random, so the order is the same every time the
# app opens, and it depends on the part, so the person sitting at position 4
# on one part is a different person at position 4 on the next. That is the
# point: an impression formed on one part cannot follow a student into the
# next one.

response_order_key <-
  function(.student_id, .slot_id) {
    # The part goes first. Appended to the end it would only move each key by
    # a digit or two, every key by about the same amount, and the ordering
    # would barely change between one part and the next; carried through the
    # whole multiplication it scatters them.

    vapply(
      str_c(.slot_id, "#", .student_id),
      \(.text) {
        Reduce(
          \(.carry, .code) (.carry * 131 + .code) %% 2147483647,
          utf8ToInt(.text),
          7
        )
      },
      numeric(1)
    )
  }

# html --------------------------------------------------------------------

# The panels are built as HTML strings, so anything taken from a submission
# is escaped on the way in.

escape_html <-
  function(.text) {
    .text %>%
      str_replace_all("&", "&amp;") %>%
      str_replace_all("<", "&lt;") %>%
      str_replace_all(">", "&gt;")
  }

# Lesson prose is markdown, so a question is rendered rather than printed.
# commonmark is what shiny itself uses for markdown(), so it is present
# wherever this app runs; the fallback keeps the panel readable if it is not.

markdown_html <-
  function(.text) {
    if (is.na(.text) || !nzchar(str_trim(.text))) return("")

    if (requireNamespace("commonmark", quietly = TRUE)) {
      return(commonmark::markdown_html(.text))
    }

    str_c("<p>", escape_html(.text), "</p>")
  }

code_panel <-
  function(.code, .class = "gd-code") {
    if (is.na(.code) || !nzchar(str_trim(.code))) {
      return("<p class=\"gd-empty\">No answer given.</p>")
    }

    str_c(
      "<pre class=\"", .class, "\">",
      escape_html(str_trim(.code)),
      "</pre>"
    )
  }

# A finding with more than one part is a list, not a run-on sentence.

finding_list <-
  function(.label, .items) {
    if (!length(.items)) return("")

    if (length(.items) == 1) {
      return(
        str_c(
          "<p class=\"gd-finding\"><strong>", .label, ":</strong> ",
          escape_html(.items[1]), "</p>"
        )
      )
    }

    str_c(
      "<p class=\"gd-finding\"><strong>", .label, ":</strong></p>",
      "<ul class=\"gd-finding-list\">",
      str_c("<li>", escape_html(.items), "</li>", collapse = ""),
      "</ul>"
    )
  }

# The functions an answer used that the assignment does not permit, saying
# which of them the first-use rule actually charged for.

outside_the_list <-
  function(.slot) {
    used <- .slot$unapproved[[1]] %||% character(0)

    if (!length(used)) return(character(0))

    charged <- .slot$unapproved_charged[[1]] %||% character(0)

    str_c(
      "`", used, "()`",
      if_else(
        used %in% charged,
        " -- charged here",
        " -- already charged at an earlier question"
      )
    )
  }

badge <-
  function(.text, .class) {
    str_c("<span class=\"gd-badge ", .class, "\">", .text, "</span>")
  }

# A submission's lines, read once per file.

submission_lines <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

lines_of <-
  function(.path) {
    if (is.na(.path) || !fs::file_exists(.path)) return(character(0))

    if (!exists(.path, envir = submission_lines)) {
      assign(.path, read_lines(.path), envir = submission_lines)
    }

    get(.path, envir = submission_lines)
  }

# The comment block that sits against an answer, above or below it.
#
# Walks away from the answer taking comment lines, stepping over a blank
# line only when a comment follows it, and stopping at the first line of
# code. Nothing else is shown: the question is already on the page, and the
# rest of the file belongs to other answers.

adjacent_comment <-
  function(.lines, .from, .step, .limit = 8L) {
    kept <- integer(0)

    at <- .from

    while (at >= 1 && at <= length(.lines) && length(kept) < .limit) {
      line <- str_trim(.lines[at])

      if (str_starts(line, "#")) {
        kept <- c(kept, at)

        # A section header opens the next question. Take it, so the gap
        # before it is visible, and stop: what follows belongs to another
        # answer.

        if (str_detect(line, "-{5,}\\s*$")) break

        at <- at + .step

        next
      }

      if (line == "") {
        ahead <- at + .step

        while (ahead >= 1 && ahead <= length(.lines) &&
               str_trim(.lines[ahead]) == "") {
          ahead <- ahead + .step
        }

        inside <-
          ahead >= 1 &&
            ahead <= length(.lines) &&
            str_starts(str_trim(.lines[ahead]), "#")

        if (!inside) break

        kept <- c(kept, at)

        at <- at + .step

        next
      }

      break
    }

    sort(kept)
  }

# The answer as it sits in the student's own file, with the comment written
# against it above and below.
#
# A comment a student wrote about their answer usually falls outside the
# slot, because a slot begins after the question's own comment and ends
# where the next one starts. Judging the answer alone would mean judging it
# without the sentence they wrote to explain it. The answer itself is shown
# untrimmed, so a blank line they left is visible too.

answer_in_context <-
  function(.slot) {
    lines <- lines_of(.slot$submission_path %||% NA_character_)

    if (!length(lines) || is.na(.slot$line_start %||% NA_integer_)) {
      return(code_panel(.slot$answer))
    }

    span <- .slot$line_start:.slot$line_end

    numbers <-
      c(
        adjacent_comment(lines, .slot$line_start - 1L, -1L),
        span,
        adjacent_comment(lines, .slot$line_end + 1L, 1L)
      )

    rendered <-
      map_chr(
        numbers,
        \(.n) {
          str_c(
            "<span class=\"gd-line",
            if (.n %in% span) "" else " gd-line-context",
            "\"><span class=\"gd-lineno\">",
            formatC(.n, width = 3),
            "</span>",
            escape_html(lines[.n]),
            "</span>"
          )
        }
      )

    # Joined with nothing: each line is already a block, and a newline
    # between two blocks inside a `pre` doubles the leading.

    str_c(
      "<pre class=\"gd-code gd-context\">",
      str_c(rendered, collapse = ""),
      "</pre>"
    )
  }

# what is on screen -------------------------------------------------------

# Every part of the problem set, in the order a reader meets them. The
# question is chosen by walking this list rather than from a picker.

part_table <-
  function(.run) {
    .run$slots %>%
      distinct(
        slot_id,
        question,
        answer_order,
        criterion,
        slot_points
      ) %>%
      arrange(question, answer_order)
  }

parts <- reactive(part_table(results()))

part_index <- reactiveVal(1L)

response_index <- reactiveVal(1L)

# Marks changed but not yet written. One row per answer, so a question is
# reviewed by clicking through it and then saved in one go.

edits <-
  reactiveVal(
    tibble(
      slot_id = integer(0),
      student_id = character(0),
      new_deduction = numeric(0),
      new_note = character(0),
      question = integer(0),
      new_style_credit = numeric(0)
    )
  )

# What the two boxes currently stand for. Held separately because an edit has
# to be captured before the boxes are pointed at another answer.

shown <- reactiveVal(NULL)

# `req()` is deliberately absent from everything below. It raises a condition
# that Shiny knows to swallow, but only while it travels untouched: raised
# inside a dplyr verb it is caught, rewrapped and loses that class, and an
# ordinary error in an observer ends the session. Empty tables and NULL do
# the same work and cannot misfire.

current_part <-
  reactive({
    rows <- parts()

    if (!nrow(rows)) return(NULL)

    rows[min(max(part_index(), 1L), nrow(rows)), ]
  })

current_responses <-
  reactive({
    part <- current_part()

    if (is.null(part)) return(results()$slots[0, ])

    results()$slots %>%
      filter(slot_id == part$slot_id) %>%
      mutate(order_key = response_order_key(student_id, slot_id)) %>%
      arrange(order_key)
  })

current_response <-
  reactive({
    rows <- current_responses()

    if (!nrow(rows)) return(NULL)

    rows[min(max(response_index(), 1L), nrow(rows)), ]
  })

# the panels --------------------------------------------------------------

output$where <-
  renderUI({
    part <- current_part()

    if (is.null(part)) return(HTML(""))

    rows <- current_responses()

    marked <- sum(rows$reviewed %||% FALSE)

    HTML(
      str_c(
        "<p class=\"gd-where\"><strong>Question ", part$question,
        "</strong> of ", max(parts()$question),
        " &middot; ", marked, " of ", nrow(rows), " answers marked",
        " &middot; built ", dashboard_built, "</p>",
        "<div class=\"gd-progress\"><div class=\"gd-progress-fill\"",
        " style=\"width: ",
        if (nrow(rows)) round(100 * marked / nrow(rows)) else 0,
        "%;\"></div></div>"
      )
    )
  })

output$question <-
  renderUI({
    part <- current_part()

    if (is.null(part)) return(HTML(""))

    siblings <- parts() %>% filter(question == part$question)

    position <- match(part$slot_id, siblings$slot_id)

    stem <-
      problem_questions()$markdown[
        problem_questions()$question == part$question
      ] %>%
      head(1) %>%
      coalesce("") %>%
      question_markdown_for_report()

    HTML(
      str_c(
        "<div class=\"gd-card\">",
        "<div class=\"gd-label\">The question</div>",
        "<div class=\"gd-stem\">", markdown_html(stem), "</div>",
        if (!is.na(part$criterion)) {
          str_c(
            "<div class=\"gd-criterion\">",
            markdown_html(part$criterion),
            "</div>"
          )
        } else {
          ""
        },
        "<p class=\"gd-points\">Part ", position, " of ", nrow(siblings),
        " &middot; ", formatC(part$slot_points, format = "f", digits = 2),
        " points</p>",
        "</div>"
      )
    )
  })

output$compare <-
  renderUI({
    part <- current_part()

    slot <- current_response()

    if (is.null(part) || is.null(slot)) return(HTML(""))

    accepted <-
      results()$key %>%
      filter(slot_id == part$slot_id) %>%
      pull(alternatives)

    key_html <-
      if (length(accepted) && length(accepted[[1]])) {
        str_c(
          map_chr(accepted[[1]], \(.code) code_panel(.code, "gd-code-key")),
          collapse = ""
        )
      } else {
        "<p class=\"gd-empty\">The key lists no answer for this part.</p>"
      }

    violations <-
      slot$violations[[1]] %>%
      pull(comment_text) %>%
      unique()

    edited <-
      edits() %>%
      filter(slot_id == slot$slot_id, student_id == slot$student_id) %>%
      nrow() > 0

    badges <-
      c(
        if (isTRUE(slot$needs_review)) {
          badge("needs review", "gd-badge-review")
        },
        if (slot$verdict == "correct") badge("correct", "gd-badge-correct"),
        if (slot$verdict == "incorrect") badge("incorrect", "gd-badge-wrong"),
        if (isTRUE(slot$reviewed)) badge("saved", "gd-badge-saved"),
        if (edited) badge("edited, not saved", "gd-badge-edited")
      )

    HTML(
      str_c(
        "<div class=\"gd-compare\">",
        "<div class=\"gd-card\">",
        "<div class=\"gd-label\">What the key accepts</div>",
        key_html,
        "</div>",
        "<div class=\"gd-card gd-response-card\">",
        "<div class=\"gd-label\">Response ", response_index(),
        " of ", nrow(current_responses()),
        if (isTRUE(input$reveal_names)) {
          str_c(" &middot; ", escape_html(slot$student_id))
        } else {
          ""
        },
        "</div>",
        answer_in_context(slot),
        "<p class=\"gd-finding\">", str_c(badges, collapse = ""), "</p>",
        if (!is.na(slot$reason)) {
          str_c("<p class=\"gd-finding\">", escape_html(slot$reason), "</p>")
        } else {
          ""
        },
        finding_list("Style", violations),
        finding_list(
          "Outside the list",
          outside_the_list(slot)
        ),
        finding_list(
          "Not required",
          parsimony_notes(slot, results()$bank)
        ),
        "</div>",
        "</div>"
      )
    )
  })

output$response_counter <-
  renderUI({
    rows <- current_responses()

    if (!nrow(rows)) return(HTML(""))

    slot <- current_response()

    HTML(
      str_c(
        "<div class=\"gd-counter\">Response ", response_index(),
        " of ", nrow(rows),
        "<span>",
        if (isTRUE(input$reveal_names)) {
          escape_html(slot$student_id)
        } else {
          "name hidden until you reveal it"
        },
        "</span></div>"
      )
    )
  })

output$part_counter <-
  renderUI({
    part <- current_part()

    if (is.null(part)) return(HTML(""))

    HTML(
      str_c(
        "<div class=\"gd-counter\">Question ", part$question,
        "<span>part ", part_index(), " of ", nrow(parts()),
        " in this problem set</span></div>"
      )
    )
  })

# The style credit this question is worth, whether it was earned, and what
# broke it. Credit is a property of the question, not of one answer: it is
# awarded when every answer in the question follows the guide.

# What the style credit for this question is worth and what broke it. The
# figure itself is an input above this: credit is awarded when every answer
# in a question follows the guide, and that is a judgement worth being able
# to overrule.

output$style_note <-
  renderUI({
    part <- current_part()

    slot <- current_response()

    if (is.null(part) || is.null(slot)) return(HTML(""))

    possible <- style_credit_rate * slot$question_points

    broke <-
      results()$slots %>%
      filter(
        student_id == slot$student_id,
        question == part$question,
        !style_clean
      ) %>%
      nrow()

    HTML(
      str_c(
        "<p class=\"gd-style-note\">of ", format_points(possible, "+"),
        " for question ", part$question, ". ",
        if (broke == 0) {
          "Every answer here follows the guide."
        } else {
          str_c(
            broke, " answer", if (broke == 1) "" else "s",
            " here break", if (broke == 1) "s" else "", " it",
            if (isTRUE(slot$style_clean)) ", but not this one." else {
              ", this one among them."
            }
          )
        },
        "</p>"
      )
    )
  })

output$unsaved <-
  renderUI({
    part <- current_part()

    waiting <-
      if (is.null(part)) {
        0
      } else {
        edits() %>%
          filter(slot_id == part$slot_id) %>%
          nrow()
      }

    HTML(
      str_c(
        "<span class=\"gd-unsaved\">",
        if (waiting) {
          str_c(waiting, " edited, not saved")
        } else {
          "nothing to save"
        },
        "</span>"
      )
    )
  })

# holding an edit ---------------------------------------------------------

# The feedback the graded file will carry for one answer: whatever was
# written in this box before, or the checks' own wording.

baseline_feedback <-
  function(.slot) {
    written <- override_reasons(.slot)

    if (!is.null(written)) return(str_c(written, collapse = "\n"))

    str_c(deduction_reasons(.slot), collapse = "\n")
  }

# The style credit this answer's question currently carries.

style_credit_now <-
  function(.slot) {
    row <-
      results()$questions %>%
      filter(
        student_id == .slot$student_id,
        question == .slot$question
      )

    if (!nrow(row)) return(0)

    row$style_credit[1]
  }

# Point the boxes at one answer, showing an unsaved edit in preference to the
# mark the pipeline proposed.

show_response <-
  function(.slot) {
    if (is.null(.slot) || !nrow(.slot)) return(invisible(NULL))

    pending <-
      edits() %>%
      filter(slot_id == .slot$slot_id, student_id == .slot$student_id)

    updateNumericInput(
      session,
      "override_deduction",
      value = if (nrow(pending)) pending$new_deduction[1] else .slot$deduction,
      max = .slot$slot_points
    )

    updateTextAreaInput(
      session,
      "override_note",
      value =
        if (nrow(pending) && !is.na(pending$new_note[1])) {
          pending$new_note[1]
        } else {
          baseline_feedback(.slot)
        }
    )

    credit <- style_credit_now(.slot)

    updateNumericInput(
      session,
      "override_style_credit",
      value =
        if (nrow(pending) && !is.na(pending$new_style_credit[1])) {
          pending$new_style_credit[1]
        } else {
          credit
        },
      max = style_credit_rate * .slot$question_points
    )

    shown(
      list(
        slot_id = .slot$slot_id,
        student_id = .slot$student_id,
        question = .slot$question,
        deduction = .slot$deduction,
        feedback = baseline_feedback(.slot),
        style_credit = credit
      )
    )
  }

# Take whatever is in the boxes into the buffer, or out of it when it has
# been put back to the mark the pipeline proposed.

capture_current <-
  function() {
    was <- shown()

    if (is.null(was)) return(invisible(NULL))

    same_deduction <-
      isTRUE(all.equal(input$override_deduction, was$deduction))

    same_feedback <-
      identical(str_trim(input$override_note), str_trim(was$feedback))

    same_credit <-
      isTRUE(all.equal(input$override_style_credit, was$style_credit))

    kept <-
      edits() %>%
      filter(!(slot_id == was$slot_id & student_id == was$student_id))

    if (same_deduction && same_feedback && same_credit) {
      edits(kept)

      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    edits(
      bind_rows(
        kept,
        tibble(
          slot_id = was$slot_id,
          student_id = was$student_id,
          question = as.integer(was$question),
          new_deduction = input$override_deduction,
          new_note =
            if (same_feedback) NA_character_ else str_trim(input$override_note),
          new_style_credit =
            if (same_credit) NA_real_ else input$override_style_credit
        )
      )
    )

    invisible(NULL)
  }

# moving ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Every move captures first, then changes position, then points the boxes at
# the new answer, in that order. An edit belongs to the answer that was on
# screen when it was made.

move_to <-
  function(.part, .response) {
    capture_current()

    part_index(.part)

    response_index(.response)

    show_response(current_response())
  }

# The run is fixed for this session, so the only thing to do at startup is
# point the boxes at the first answer of the first question.

observeEvent(
  TRUE,
  move_to(1L, 1L),
  once = TRUE
)

observeEvent(
  input$next_response,
  {
    total <- nrow(current_responses())

    if (!total) return(invisible(NULL))

    move_to(
      part_index(),
      if (response_index() >= total) 1L else response_index() + 1L
    )
  }
)

observeEvent(
  input$previous_response,
  {
    total <- nrow(current_responses())

    if (!total) return(invisible(NULL))

    move_to(
      part_index(),
      if (response_index() <= 1L) total else response_index() - 1L
    )
  }
)

observeEvent(
  input$next_part,
  {
    total <- nrow(parts())

    if (!total) return(invisible(NULL))

    move_to(if (part_index() >= total) 1L else part_index() + 1L, 1L)
  }
)

observeEvent(
  input$previous_part,
  {
    total <- nrow(parts())

    if (!total) return(invisible(NULL))

    move_to(if (part_index() <= 1L) total else part_index() - 1L, 1L)
  }
)

observeEvent(
  input$reset_response,
  {
    slot <- current_response()

    if (is.null(slot)) return(invisible(NULL))

    edits(
      edits() %>%
        filter(!(slot_id == slot$slot_id & student_id == slot$student_id))
    )

    show_response(slot)
  }
)

# accepting an unexpected answer ------------------------------------------

# Shown only under an answer the comparison marked wrong. Accepting it
# appends the code to the key file as a new alternative and marks every
# matching proposal on this question correct.

output$accept_answer_ui <-
  renderUI({
    slot <- current_response()

    if (is.null(slot) || slot$verdict != "incorrect") return(NULL)

    div(
      class = "gd-nav gd-nav-row",
      actionButton(
        "accept_answer",
        "Accept this answer and add it to the key"
      )
    )
  })

observeEvent(
  input$accept_answer,
  {
    slot <- current_response()

    if (is.null(slot) || slot$verdict != "incorrect") {
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    before <- results()

    updated <-
      accept_alternative(
        before,
        slot$student_id,
        slot$slot_id
      )

    added <-
      length(updated$key$alternatives[updated$key$slot_id == slot$slot_id][[1]]) >
        length(before$key$alternatives[before$key$slot_id == slot$slot_id][[1]])

    if (!added) {
      showNotification(
        "The key already accepts this approach.",
        duration = 4,
        type = "warning"
      )

      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    marked <-
      sum(
        updated$slots$verdict == "correct" &
          before$slots$verdict != "correct"
      )

    results(updated)

    # An unsaved edit on this answer would otherwise keep showing the old
    # mark in the boxes.

    edits(
      edits() %>%
        filter(!(slot_id == slot$slot_id & student_id == slot$student_id))
    )

    showNotification(
      str_c(
        "Added to the key. ",
        marked,
        " answer",
        if (marked == 1) "" else "s",
        " on this question ",
        if (marked == 1) "is" else "are",
        " now marked correct."
      ),
      duration = 6,
      type = "message"
    )

    show_response(current_response())
  }
)

# saving ------------------------------------------------------------------

observeEvent(
  input$save_part,
  {
    capture_current()

    part <- current_part()

    if (is.null(part)) return(invisible(NULL))

    this_part <-
      edits() %>%
      filter(slot_id == part$slot_id)

    if (!nrow(this_part)) {
      showNotification(
        "Nothing has been changed on this question.",
        duration = 3,
        type = "warning"
      )

      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    results(apply_overrides(results(), this_part))

    edits(
      edits() %>%
        filter(slot_id != part$slot_id)
    )

    showNotification(
      str_c(
        "Saved ", nrow(this_part), " response",
        if (nrow(this_part) == 1) "" else "s",
        "."
      ),
      duration = 3,
      type = "message"
    )

    show_response(current_response())
  }
)

observeEvent(
  input$write_reports,
  {
    run <- results()

    paths <-
      write_graded_reports(
        run$problem_set,
        run$index,
        run$slots,
        run$questions,
        .bank = run$bank
      )

    showNotification(
      str_c("Wrote ", length(paths), " graded files."),
      type = "message"
    )

    # A review flag is the grader's and never appears on a graded file, so
    # files written past an open flag carry a provisional mark silently.

    open_flags <-
      sum(run$slots$needs_review & !run$slots$reviewed, na.rm = TRUE)

    if (open_flags > 0) {
      showNotification(
        str_c(
          open_flags,
          " flagged response",
          if (open_flags == 1) " is" else "s are",
          " still unreviewed. The written files carry no review markers."
        ),
        duration = 8,
        type = "warning"
      )
    }
  }
)

# cohort ------------------------------------------------------------------

output$score_distribution <-
  renderPlot({
    ggplot(results()$students, aes(x = total)) +
      geom_histogram(
        binwidth = 0.5,
        fill = "#292093",
        colour = "white"
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Total points",
        y = "Students",
        title = "How the class scored"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
  })

output$question_difficulty <-
  renderPlot({
    results()$questions %>%
      group_by(question) %>%
      summarize(
        share = mean(earned / question_points),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = factor(question), y = share)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#9db0e6") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      labs(
        x = "Question",
        y = "Mean share earned",
        title = "Which questions were hardest"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
  })

output$violation_table <-
  renderDT(
    {
      results()$slots %>%
        select(student_id, violations) %>%
        unnest(violations) %>%
        count(comment_text, sort = TRUE) %>%
        rename(Violation = comment_text, Count = n)
    },
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 8, dom = "tp")
  )

output$unapproved_table <-
  renderDT(
    {
      results()$slots %>%
        select(student_id, question, unapproved) %>%
        unnest(unapproved) %>%
        count(unapproved, question, sort = TRUE) %>%
        rename(Function = unapproved, Question = question, Count = n)
    },
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 8, dom = "tp")
  )
```
